descriptor: Operations tools for scheduling and timing

voice.summary: Tickwell is the sort of site a tired sysadmin trusts: terse, accurate and without ornament. It translates cron into plain English and shows the next five runs.
dos: Translate each field into a plain English phrase
Show times with the zone, local or UTC
donts: Do not use cute metaphors for schedules
Never show a run time without a zone

taglines: Read the schedule, not the stars
boilerplate: Tickwell is an operations tools site whose Cron Explainer turns five-field expressions into plain English, shows the next five runs and maps how busy each day will be.

microcopy.success: Expression parsed. Next runs are below.
microcopy.error: That expression has the wrong number of fields. Use five.
microcopy.empty: Type a cron expression to begin.

logo.note: A dial hints at a clock face without turning into a clock cliche.
